en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4704 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni, it is reported that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) saw a man who had two sons.

The man kissed one of them and left the other.
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said to him, "Why did you not treat them equally?"
